subject: CONTROL clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.16.4 "Data-name-1 shall not reference a zero-length group item" -> OK 6). Zero-length group per §8.5.4 (cite.py --check 8.5.4 "A group data item containing only an occurs-depending table in which the number of occurrences is zero" -> OK 1)): item 1 (group of only an ODO table) and item 2 (group of only a zero-length subordinate, recursively ODO or DYNAMIC LENGTH) are always rejected at bind by ControlOperandShapeViolation's SR5 arm (OdoModel.TableUnder, cite OK §13.18.16.3 5)) and SR7 arm (HasVariableLengthSubordinate, cite OK §13.18.16.3 7)); items 3/4 are elementary, not groups; item 5 (a variable-length logical record whose runtime length is zero) is a run-time state the GR constrains the PROGRAM against with no exception condition or specified outcome, so no implementation action is required. Existing negatives pb177-control-occurs-depending / pb177-control-variable-length-group are SR5/SR7 witnesses whose groups have nonzero minimum length, so they do not witness GR6 as such; test-ref empty. || Editions (adjudicator): 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (text as in 2023; Annex E carries no edition note for it)
